items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: And Joe Moyes, we just pity him, say he couldn't run with that bass, you remember?

ctx.x: Melvin Frank taking about six hours to walk from, uh, Rene, to St. Claude back to a prayer. Back, back on. Back on Johnson, why she used to live back on Johnson Street, damn. Back to a full block. Take, take him about six hours to walk four blocks. When they got to shootin', Melvin Frank say he dropped his stick. He went to runnin', you know. And Melvin Frank beat me to the car line. And he got to here and say, I thought you wasn't coming. And Joe Moyes, we just pity him, say he couldn't run with that bass, you…
